## Summary

What this change does and why.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `go test ./...` passes.
- [ ] `go generate ./...` was run and the generated files are committed.
- [ ] Every commit carries a DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or tenant host names in the change.
- [ ] No em-dashes or arrow glyphs; comments describe current behaviour.
- [ ] User-readable text calls the platform's admin tool the
      "application manager".
